title: Heavenly Fate Countdown
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji prepared to choose among three dead ends, the Tianji Record in his arms suddenly trembled—a fourth light was burning on a forbidden page he had never touched.

text.content: Blood seeped from Chen Ji's chest, each drop like stolen Heavenly Fate. Ling Yuan's figure twisted in the blood, that aged face bearing an almost manic grin, as if victory was assured. Yet just as those fangs were about to touch Chen Ji's vital point, the Tianji Record burst forth with unprecedented light—not the faint glow of a fragment, but complete, destructive brilliance capable of tearing through spacetime. Ling Yuan's fangs froze in that light, his pupils contracting violently, as if he had witnessed something that should not exist in this world.

"No... this is impossible!" For the first time, Ling Yuan's voice trembled. "The complete form of the Tianji Record... when did you—" Chen Ji gave no answer. His consciousness had sunk into the deepest part of the Tianji Record, where a seal he had never touched was slowly unraveling. The thirty-day countdown, like a burning brand, was seared into the deepest part of his soul.

dialogue.content: Thirty days... the dimensional rift will permanently stabilize in thirty days. Then, the Three Realms will no longer be the Three Realms, but become pasture for higher-dimensional beings, and we... everyone, will become their livestock.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fluctuated violently within the Tianji Record, that originally blurry figure now showing signs of agitation: "You finally saw it. When Xiao Xuan passed the Tianji Record to you, this was what he feared most... thirty days is Heaven's final ultimatum, and also your last chance." Chen Ji felt the intense pain from his chest, his Heavenly Fate Value visibly draining. Every second, he could feel his destiny being devoured by that rift.

dialogue.content: "After thirty days, no matter what you choose, the rift will stabilize. The only difference is—will you be the one to close it, or will higher-dimensional beings take it over?" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of desolation. "Heaven's Eye has waited for this day far too long."

text.content: Ling Yuan's attack finally landed, yet the Tianji Record's light formed an absolute barrier. Ling Yuan's full-force strike was like a mayfly trying to shake a tree before that light—not even a ripple could be stirred. "You..." Ling Yuan's expression changed dramatically. "What exactly did you see?" For the first time, genuine fear appeared in his voice. Chen Ji slowly raised his head, the corner of his mouth curving into a mocking arc—that smile was more chilling than his wounds.

dialogue.content: "I saw something you could never imagine, old man." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "Like Heaven's Eye's true plan. For instance... that you're merely a discarded piece on its chessboard."

text.content: Ling Yuan's face instantly turned ashen. However, Chen Ji gave him no time to react, his consciousness already sinking back into the depths of the Tianji Record, the countdown images flashing before his eyes like a revolving lantern. After thirty days, the dimensional rift will stabilize completely. Then, the Three Realms will be permanently taken over by higher-dimensional beings, all living things becoming extensions of their will. And before that, he must make a choice.

The Tianji Record's image unfolded before Chen Ji's eyes, three paths like three burning chains, each leading to a different ending. First path: Close the rift. The Three Realms will return to normal, but the price is Chen Ji must offer himself as sacrifice, burning all his Heavenly Fate to achieve the rift's permanent closure. This means—death.

Second path: Fuse with the dimension. Reach some kind of coexistence agreement with higher-dimensional beings, allowing the Three Realms to become their projection in this dimension. This won't lead to the Three Realms' destruction, but all living things will lose their free will, becoming puppets of higher-dimensional beings. And Chen Ji, as the negotiator, might retain part of himself.

Third path: Abandon resistance. Disband the Tianji Record, let fate develop naturally. This won't change the final outcome, but at least Chen Ji could live his last thirty days like a human rather than a sacrifice. This is the easiest choice, and also the most cowardly choice.

dialogue.content: "So Heaven's Eye has been forcing me to choose from these three things from the start?" Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that laughter carrying a hint of madness. "Does it think I will乖乖submit? Does it think I will follow its script?" Mo Xiansheng remained silent, but something like anticipation seemed to flicker in his eyes.

choice.prompt: The thirty-day countdown hung like a sword over Chen Ji's head, and he must make a choice. Every path leads to the abyss, but there must be one path... that might lead to light.

choices.description: Offer oneself as sacrifice, burn all Heavenly Fate to purchase the Three Realms' peace. This is Heaven's predetermined most "perfect" ending, but it means Chen Ji's complete annihilation.
choices.visible_cost: Lose life, Heavenly Fate Value drops to zero, vanish forever
choices.visible_reward: Three Realms at peace, Chen Nian rescued, everyone you care about safe
choices.risk_hint: This is the ending Heaven most hopes you will choose—too perfect, too perfect to be true

text.content: Chen Ji reached out his hand and touched that burning chain. In an instant, endless information flooded his mind—the specific method to close the rift, and... a deliberately hidden flaw. He saw Heaven's Eye's layout, but also saw a variable it never anticipated.

choices.description: Negotiate with higher-dimensional beings, let the Three Realms coexist in some form. This path is full of compromises, but might preserve the flickering hope.
choices.visible_cost: Lose free will, become a spokesperson for higher-dimensional beings
choices.visible_reward: Retain part of self, possibility to secretly gather strength
choices.risk_hint: Higher-dimensional beings won't easily trust a human's sincerity—you must pay a sufficient price to prove yourself

text.content: Chen Ji felt an incomparably vast power seeping into his consciousness—that was the gaze of higher-dimensional beings. It was evaluating him,scrutinizinging him, considering whether to accept this insignificant human's proposal. A chill rose along his spine—he must prove his worth under that gaze.

choices.description: Disband the Tianji Record, stop struggling against fate. In the final thirty days, perhaps you can do things you truly want—like finding Chen Nian.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all chances to change fate
choices.visible_reward: Thirty days of freedom, possibility of finding Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Are you sure you want to give up before finding your sister? She's still waiting for you somewhere

text.content: The moment Chen Ji disbanded the Tianji Record, he felt an unprecedented lightness. However, at the same time, a blurry image surfaced in his mind—Chen Nian's figure, in some dark place, reaching out her hand toward him. In that moment, his heart tightened violently.

As Chen Ji's consciousness wandered among these three paths, a deliberately hidden piece of information suddenly surged from the depths of the Tianji Record. That was a memory erased by Heaven's Eye—Chen Xuan's final moment before death. Chen Ji saw his ancestor, saw what he said to the Tianji Record in his dying moments.

dialogue.content: "Xiao Xuan said... the fourth page of the Tianji Record was left for 'those who can see through fate.'" Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became agitated. "And the condition to open the fourth page is—to find a fourth path beyond the three dead ends."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. The fourth page... a page he had never seen. The Tianji Record fragments had always been three pages, he never knew a fourth page existed. And now, that seal was slowly loosening because of his desperate situation. A fourth path, a path not in Heaven's script.

text.content: "So that's how it is..." Chen Ji's voice carried a note of understanding. "The fourth path is hidden right here."

text.content: Chen Ji forced himself to calm down, beginning to deduce the consequences of each choice in his mind. Closing the rift means sacrifice, but can save everyone; fusing with the dimension means compromise, but might preserve the flickering hope; abandoning resistance means cowardice, but at least can find Chen Nian... every path is a dead end, every path leads to the abyss.

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng is the guardian left by Chen Xuan; perhaps he knows more clues about the fourth path.
choices.visible_cost: Time consumption, possibly receiving unwanted information
choices.visible_reward: Key information, clearer understanding of the situation
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng only says what should be said; he will not reveal information beyond his permitted scope

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul within the Tianji Record slightly fluctuated, as if hesitating. After a long while, he slowly spoke: "Xiao Xuan said the key to the fourth path lies not in choosing, but in 'creation.' Heaven can only set the framework of choices, but it cannot predict things that have not been created."

text.content: "'Creation...'" Chen Ji murmured, repeating the word. An idea gradually formed in his mind—if Heaven's Eye sets the framework of choices, then what he needs to do is not choose, but break the framework itself. Three paths, each a dead end. But what if he could... step on all three paths simultaneously?

Ling Yuan finally sensed something was wrong. The Tianji Record's light on Chen Ji was pulsating at a strange frequency, as if resonating with some deeper power. "What are you doing?!" For the first time, genuine panic appeared in Ling Yuan's voice. He wanted to strike and stop this, but the Tianji Record's light had already formed an absolute domain, isolating him completely.

dialogue.content: "I'm doing something you will never understand." Chen Ji slowly stood up, his wounds still bleeding, but his eyes clearer than ever. "You've lived all these years, always living within the circle Heaven drew for you, never thinking that—the circle itself is the greatest cage."

text.content: The seal on the fourth page of the Tianji Record began to crack under Chen Ji's will. That was not passive breaking, but active—creation. An entirely new path was taking shape in Chen Ji's consciousness, belonging to none of Heaven's predetermined three paths, yet connected to all three. This was a path Chen Ji himself created, a path that had never existed in fate.

However, just as the fourth page was about to fully unfold, an icy consciousness suddenly enveloped Chen Ji's entire body. That was Heaven's Eye's gaze—it had finally noticed the anomaly. "Interesting." A voice beyond time and space rang in Chen Ji's mind. "You are the most interesting piece I've ever seen. Then... let me see how far you can go." As the voice fell, the seal on the fourth page abruptly reinforced, as if it had never loosened.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji violently opened his eyes, a mouthful of blood spurting out. Heaven's Eye's suppression was more terrifying than he imagined, but the curve at the corner of his mouth rose even higher. "Did you see that..." he murmured. "You're afraid too. Otherwise, you wouldn't have acted personally."

text.content: Ling Yuan was completely frozen at this point. He had never seen anyone able to stand before Heaven's Eye's gaze, let alone smile under that gaze. "What... what kind of monster are you?" His voice trembled, for the first time genuinely fearing this young man he had always regarded as waste. Chen Ji gave no answer, only slowly raising his hand to wipe the blood from the corner of his mouth.

"I'm not a monster." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "I'm just someone who doesn't want to follow your script. Thirty days... is enough. Enough for me to find a way to open the fourth page, enough for me to walk a path you never anticipated." The Tianji Record faintly heated in his arms, as if responding to his determination. Ling Yuan's fangs still hung in mid-air, but that seemingly certain strike could no longer fall.

In the distance, a violent Spiritual Energy fluctuation suddenly came from the direction of Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji's eyes slightly narrowed—that was Su Qingyao's aura, and also... Chen Nian's aura. The gears of fate are accelerating, and the thirty-day countdown has begun.
